sources.title: String theory from maximal supersymmetry

evidence.text: On-shell N=4 superspace packages component amplitudes and their Ward identities. A basis change produces a six-term NMHV identity relating Z1=A6[z1 z2 z3 z̄3 z̄1 z̄2] to its cyclic momentum relabelings. The identity is imposed order by order in the EFT expansion.

sources.title: String theory from maximal supersymmetry

evidence.text: Dispersion relations express Wilson coefficients as positive spectral moments with Legendre-polynomial weights. SDPB implements crossing and additional null constraints; eliminating g and fixing a2,0/a0,0 permits many nonlinear relations to be imposed as linear constraints on each numerical slice.

sources.title: String theory from maximal supersymmetry

evidence.text: Bottom-up amplitude construction matches residues to lower-point products and parametrizes remaining local polynomials. Z1 has poles only in channels 34, 234, and 345. BCFW shifts preserve momentum conservation on poles; the authors use rational kinematics and finite-field methods for large linear systems.
